title: Joey Boy - The Wild Cowboy
prompt:
[Intro][Acoustic Guitar][Twangy Western Style]
The sun sets low on the dusty trail
A lone rider whistles an old tale
Boots in the stirrups, hat pulled low
Where the wild winds blow, that's where he'll go

[Verse][Electric Guitar Riff][Driving Country Rock]
Joey Boy rides through the canyon deep
With a six-string guitar and secrets to keep
From Texas plains to the Nevada sky
He'll chase that horizon 'til the day he dies
Whiskey in his flask, dust on his boots
Living life free, no time for disputes
The desert is his home, the stars his guide
With every sunset, he's along for the ride

[Pre-Chorus][Harmonica][Building Energy]
Oh, the campfire burns and the coyotes cry
Joey Boy sings as the night drifts by
No fences can hold him, no town can tame
This wild cowboy with a rebel name

[Chorus][Full Band][Anthemic Country Rock]
Joey Boy, Joey Boy, riding so free
Chasing the sunset across the prairie
With his guitar strumming and his spirit wild
Forever remaining a desert child
Joey Boy, Joey Boy, hear his song
Where he belongs is where he rides along
Through the canyons and the mesas tall
Joey Boy answers the wild west call

[Verse 2][Slide Guitar][Gritty Western]
Met a girl in Santa Fe with eyes like coal
Tried to settle down but it took its toll
The open road called his name once more
Left her a letter and walked out the door
Some men are born to roam the land
With a restless heart and a gunless hand
Joey Boy knows what the eagles know
True freedom means letting everything go

[Bridge][Stripped Acoustic][Emotional Vocals]
Sometimes at night when the campfire's low
He wonders about the life he'll never know
But then the wind whispers through the sage
And he remembers why he turned the page

[Chorus][Full Band][Powerful Energy]
Joey Boy, Joey Boy, riding so free
Chasing the sunset across the prairie
With his guitar strumming and his spirit wild
Forever remaining a desert child
Joey Boy, Joey Boy, hear his song
Where he belongs is where he rides along
Through the canyons and the mesas tall
Joey Boy answers the wild west call

[Outro][Acoustic Fade][Reflective]
The sun rises slow on a brand new day
Joey Boy saddles up and rides away
Into the legend, into the song
The wild cowboy rides forever on...

gpt_description_prompt: Authentic country rock with twangy acoustic guitars, driving electric riffs, harmonica accents, and dusty western atmosphere. Raw vocals with outlaw attitude, live drum feel, slide guitar solos. Inspired by classic Americana and desert road trip soundtracks.
